hypotheses.hypothesis: Inference at the true independent episode or seed unit prevents pseudoreplication-driven causal promotion.
counterhypotheses: The experimenter may identify the wrong cluster hierarchy.
Episode sign-flip still requires symmetry/exchangeability and can be miscalibrated.
Few independent episodes can make the correct test too weak to decide.
hypotheses.required_next_test: Registered episode hierarchy plus simulation-calibrated cluster/hierarchical inference; report power without reverting to ticks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A dependence-aware null ensemble with abstention on disagreement is safer than full tick shuffling.
counterhypotheses: Circular shifts can be conservative and lose power.
Circular and block nulls are invalid when stationarity or their invariants fail.
Concordant unconditional nulls can still mistake a shared regime for a direct path.
hypotheses.required_next_test: Validate null invariants per regime; add context conditioning/local surrogates and abstain under unresolved common-driver risk.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Preregistered or leakage-safe cross-fit macro selection prevents the optimizer's-curse emergence artifact.
counterhypotheses: Random folds leak temporal dependence and regimes.
A macrostate may be genuinely local to a regime and appear to fail global holdout.
Cross-fitting reduces effective sample size and can hide weak real mechanisms.
hypotheses.required_next_test: Leave-episode, leave-context and forward-time splits with candidate-count and leakage receipts; estimate local-regime effects separately.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Estimator multiverses plus redundancy and entropy bounds prevent additive synergy overcount.
counterhypotheses: PID estimators encode different axioms and need not converge to one privileged value.
Finite-sample estimator agreement can be shared bias.
Intervention-based PEID removes input redundancy only under its maximum-entropy intervention model.
hypotheses.required_next_test: Non-overlapping decompositions or explicit redundancy accounting; report axiom choice, calibration and disagreement as UNKNOWN.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pathwise causal abstraction tests and excluded-variable interventions detect endpoint-valid hidden mechanisms.
counterhypotheses: Exhaustive intervention over all hidden variables is impossible in a large system.
Flexible alignment maps can make abstraction tests vacuous.
Interventions can create unreachable or off-manifold states with ambiguous interpretation.
hypotheses.required_next_test: Constrain the alignment family, test intermediate receipts, alternative paths and sampled excluded variables, and retain a bounded hidden-path risk.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Receiver-complete GWT receipts plus matched ablation/rescue can convert broadcast observations into bounded causal-use evidence.
counterhypotheses: Decodable or verbalizable workspace content may not be causally used.
Ablation effects may reflect nonspecific capacity damage rather than workspace function.
Layer-depth ignition is a structural proxy, not temporal recurrence.
Functional access evidence does not establish phenomenal consciousness.

observations.literature_delta: J-space uses matched causal perturbations; Ignition Index explicitly defers causal amnesic probing and disallows consciousness inference.

hypotheses.required_next_test: Frozen matched baseline/lesion/rescue and truthful/shuffled/no-reentry runs on registered Andreas Ubuntu with receiver and outcome receipts.
